about: generated by generate.ts from e2e/boundaries.json; do not edit

lab.start-trace: the body starts its continuous file (trace_open source continuous) before anything else; never the 90-second ring
lab.send: {command, act}: put an act on the body (act is {$ref} of a fixture value, or "lab:<name>": slow-walk (about 20 s), unreachable-dig (fails by itself), instant-eat, dig-down, wait-in-queue)
lab.enqueue: {items}: put queue items behind the running one, each with after/dependsOn/pre (the head's envelope)
lab.set-body: {hp, food, ...}: set the bot's state with the lab's own commands (RCON), not by playing
lab.rcon: {cmd}: a server command through the lab (summon, kill, tp, effect, execute in ...)
lab.summon: {entity, near, tag}: a monster near the bot
lab.kill-bot: {moment}: /kill in running_hand | waiting_for_reflex | queued | awaiting_model; then mark the death
lab.hold-receipt: {command, until}: the lab keeps the body's receipt from the head until the named condition
lab.release-receipt: {command}: let the held receipt go to the head
lab.dup-poll: {command}: send the poll that carries the command's receipt twice
lab.disconnect-body: cut the body's connection and connect again (a new connectionId)
lab.restart-head: {stopAt, startAt}: stop the head, start it again (a new headBoot); the order of the receipt and the stop is the scene's
lab.swap-lease: renew the lease while the item waits
lab.portal: {from, to}: walk through a portal; the life must not change
lab.start-owner: {name, command}: a command takes the motor port (keys, shield, path goal)
lab.late-cleanup: {owner, calls}: the old owner's slow cleanup runs after the new owner started
lab.mark: {kind, ...}: write a mark into meta.json (deaths, injections) at the time it happened

head.answer: {turn, reads, tool, args}: the scripted model's answer at its n-th turn; `reads` are the commands whose receipts must be in the input
head.probe: {kind}: write a probes.jsonl line (plan_snapshot, plan_decisions, plan_write, request_bytes, one_time_fact)
